text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Can you feel the excitement in the air,<n>Trainer?
You could cut the tension<n>with a knife.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The eyes of the crowd are on us,<n>watching our
every move.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A fitting stage to demonstrate my<n>skills, don't you
agree?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But of course. Victory is the podium<n>from which
the Emperor leads her<n>people!
